title: perf(i18n): load locale catalogues on demand — nine packs leave the console's eager closure
body:
Fixes #7479

Option C of the ruling on objectui#7399, adopted by the maintainer 2026-09-03.

## ⛔ Merge-queue ejection, and the repair — read this first

This branch was **ejected from the merge queue**. It was green on its own head
(37/37 at 08:27Z), was armed, entered the queue at 10:05Z, and CI failed on the
QUEUE ref — the queue rebuilding it on the `main` of that moment. `main` moved on
without it and is now `6df26f025`.

The one failure, verbatim, from `Test (shard 1/4)` of run 34587487676:

```
AssertionError: an importer with no read row is a file the report says nothing about: expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal []

- Expected
+ Received
- []
+ [
+   "packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/outboundAgentText.ts",
+   "packages/plugin-grid/demo/main.tsx",
+ ]
```

**Green on the branch and red in the queue because neither change is wrong
alone.** The assertion `reports at least one read for EVERY non-test importer`
arrived on `main` from objectui#9046 AFTER this branch last built. Both files it
names are files this PR changed, and both appear in the consumer census below.
⇒ it is this PR's to repair, not a flake and not someone else's failure.

⭐ **Root cause: the pack-object instrument has two halves, and this PR had
widened only one of them.** `derivePackObjectImporters()` picks the POPULATION
with a SUBSTRING test over the grep line. `packBindingsOf()` decides what each
member is then read AS, and it matched the module specifier for EQUALITY and
matched only export names that ARE packs.

| file | how this PR changed the way it reaches a pack | still in the population | read rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outboundAgentText.ts` | `en` + `zh` imports → `getLoadedBuiltInLocales()` | yes — this PR widened the alternation for it | 2 → **0** |
| `plugin-grid/demo/main.tsx` | the entry → the `@object-ui/i18n/locales` subpath | yes — a substring test matches a subpath | 10 → **0** |

**Measured, not reasoned** — the same walk run over both versions of each file,
rows per file:

```
packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/outboundAgentText.ts   pre-card  2  ->  0
packages/plugin-grid/demo/main.tsx                       pre-card 10  ->  0
packages/app-shell/src/chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx          pre-card  7  ->  6
```

⭐ **The third line is the one nothing named, and it is why the repair belongs in
the deriver.** `LoadingScreen.tsx` still imports `en`, so it still had six rows
and the assertion stayed green on it — the row it LOST is its
`getLoadedBuiltInLocales()[base]` read, a real pack read the report had gone
silent about behind a passing test. The two named files were the visible half of
a blind spot with three instances.

**Do those two files still READ keys off a pack object, or do they genuinely only
bind one?** Measured answer: both still read. `outboundAgentText.ts` performs the
same dynamic `ai?.[key]` read on a catalogue it now asks the registry for instead
of importing. `main.tsx`'s ten whole-pack `resources` bindings are unchanged to
the byte and only the specifier moved, to the published all-ten door the entry no
longer fronts — and a whole-pack hand-off is a depth-0 row that instrument is
built to record, not an absence. Neither file stopped reading. ⇒ the honest
repair is the other half of the widening this PR already started.

**What changed in the gate, exactly, and why it stays as strict as it was.** Two
functions in `scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`:

- `isPackModuleSpecifier()` — the binding walk now accepts the pack package **and
  its subpaths**, scoped to the `/` separator so a package merely sharing the
  prefix binds nothing. This makes the binding walk agree with a population test
  that was always a substring test.
- `packMapAccessorBindingsOf()` — resolves `getLoadedBuiltInLocales` in its OWN
  map, apart from the pack bindings, because it is a FUNCTION and the map is its
  call's RESULT. A chain climbs off the CALL and strips a locale tag exactly as
  one off `builtInLocales` does. Held apart so a property of the function itself
  can never be reported as a catalogue key.

⛔ **Nothing was skipped, disabled, quarantined or relaxed**, and no assertion was
changed to allow a non-empty list. The direction is strictly stricter: every row
that existed still exists, three rows that had gone dark come back, and no row is
dropped or reclassified. Run against the PRE-CARD sources, the repaired deriver
returns **2 / 10 / 7** — identical to what `main`'s deriver returns there — so the
widening changes nothing about shapes that were already visible.

**The ablation — two legs, one per half of the repair.** Mutation shown on disk
BEFORE each run; restore proven **by state**, never by an exit code:

```
HEAD blob for scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs = 141f7d138464a408fc6ba14d3a7b36b76f625cb6

LEG subpath   — isPackModuleSpecifier reverted to equality
  injected marker ABLATION-SUBPATH occurrences = 1
  mutated blob = 04bf4326defd0a756b626463384de0136180ab33   (differs from HEAD)
  vitest exit 1 — 2 failed | 104 passed
    x a pack imported from a published SUBPATH is read exactly as one imported from the entry
    x reports at least one read for EVERY non-test importer -> ["packages/plugin-grid/demo/main.tsx"]
  restore: blob back to 141f7d138..., and git diff HEAD for that path EMPTY

LEG accessor  — the accessor binding never set
  injected marker ABLATION-ACCESSOR occurrences = 1
  mutated blob = fd545aeadeab6c2485ac30feac518edd3d25d0aa   (differs from HEAD)
  vitest exit 1 — 3 failed | 103 passed
    x a chain off the resident-catalogue ACCESSOR CALL resolves like one off the map
    x an accessor call indexed by a RUNTIME language is reported opaque, never as reading nothing
    x reports at least one read for EVERY non-test importer -> ["packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/outboundAgentText.ts"]
  restore: blob back to 141f7d138..., and git diff HEAD for that path EMPTY

final state: git status --porcelain EMPTY, blob = 141f7d138... = HEAD
```

Each leg names exactly ONE of the two files the queue named, so the two legs
together reproduce the ejection's own list, one half each.

**Seven new pins** in `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`, each
written as a SHAPE rather than as the file that introduced it, each with a lit
control that pre-existed the widening: the entry spelling of the same read, a
package merely sharing the prefix that must bind nothing, a property of the
accessor itself, and the accessor name imported from somewhere else.

**Brought onto current `main` by MERGE, not rebase** (`6df26f025`), per this
repo's absolute no-force-push rule. No conflicts.

### Re-verification on the merged tree

| run | result |
|---|---|
| `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts` BEFORE the repair | **exit 1 — the original failure reproduced**, same two files, same assertion |
| the same file after the repair | exit 0 — 106 tests |
| `scripts/__tests__/ packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-grid/` | exit 0 — 334 files, 6495 tests |
| `packages/app-shell/` | exit 0 — 680 files, 6593 tests |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | exit 0; `--listFiles` confirms the pin test is in that program |
| `check:eager-closure` / `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, after a full packages + console build | exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check:i18n-dead-keys` / `check:i18n-keys` / `check:i18n-drift` | exit 0 / exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check-changeset-presence` / `check-changeset-no-major` | exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check:new-line-citations` / `check:control-bytes` | exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over all 50 changed paths | NOT GOVERNED — the ordinary merge-queue route applies |

`check:eager-locale-catalogues` on the merged tree still prints the claim this
card exists for: exactly one catalogue eager (`en`), 405.5 KB gzipped deferred
across the other nine.

**Lint for this repair — a DECLARED narrowing, all three pieces of evidence.**
The repair touches only `scripts/**`, so the scope run is `pnpm lint:root`, whose
ignore patterns are exactly `packages/*/**`, `examples/*/**`, `apps/*/**` and
`docs/**` — i.e. it covers the whole area this repair is in. 1. **Population**
from eslint's own config, not from my reading of it: a grep of `eslint.config.js`
for `projectService`, `parserOptions` and a `project` key returns nothing, so
type-aware linting is OFF. 2. **Count** from `--format json`: **331 files linted,
0 errors, 32 warnings**, all pre-existing classes and none gating (no
`--max-warnings` anywhere); both files this repair touches are in that population
at 0 errors / 0 warnings. 3. **Invariance**: with type-aware linting off, no
rule's verdict on an untouched file can depend on any file in this diff.

## What a page load costs now

Two full console builds, one container, same instrument, the second differing
from the first only by this change. Control: `origin/main` `d8b4739d4`,
detached build of the pristine tree. After: `755d34a5f`, this branch's
implementation commit.

| reading                        |   control |     after |    delta |
|--------------------------------|----------:|----------:|---------:|
| eager closure, gzipped         | 3,575,370 | 3,164,817 | **−410,553** |
| eager chunks / total           |    50/518 |    51/528 |          |
| locale catalogues in it        |        10 |         1 |       −9 |
| `i18n-locales` (retired chunk) |   456,196 |         — |          |
| `i18n-locale-en`               |         — |    40,415 |          |
| `i18n-runtime`                 |         — |     5,329 |          |
| `vendor-objectstack`           | 1,236,315 | 1,236,315 |    **0** |
| `ui-components`                |   394,726 |   394,718 |   **−8** |
| `framework`                    |    80,414 |    80,430 |  **+16** |

The last three rows are the control that makes the first one readable. objectui#7399
refused "A with the cost hidden" — routing the same bytes into a chunk with a
roomier ceiling — and these three say that is not what happened: the two big
neighbours did not grow, so the bytes left the eager closure rather than moving
inside it.

`pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues` on the after build:

```
Exactly one locale catalogue is eager — `en`, the resident fallback —
and the other 9 are fetched on demand: zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar.

Locale catalogue chunks (gzipped):
    51.1 KB  ru  on demand        43.3 KB  es  on demand
    46.6 KB  ar  on demand        43.2 KB  zh  on demand
    45.8 KB  ja  on demand        42.9 KB  pt  on demand
    44.4 KB  fr  on demand        39.5 KB  en  EAGER (resident)
    44.1 KB  de  on demand
    43.9 KB  ko  on demand
  405.5 KB gzipped is deferred — the 9 catalogues a page load no longer fetches.
```

⚠️ The card's `~476 KB` figure for the ten is a 2026-09-02 reading and is **not**
quoted anywhere here; every number above is from these two builds.

## The contract, and the one deliberate divergence

The entry re-exports **`en` only**. Nine catalogues became
`loadBuiltInLocale(code)`, memoised, one literal `import()` specifier each.

⚠️ **`en` stays eager, and that is a choice made in the open rather than a
shortcut.** The card admits it in as many words — "no `packages/i18n/src/locales/*`
module in any eager chunk EXCEPT THE ACTIVE ONE", and "roughly NINE catalogues'
worth" — and three mechanisms require a resident catalogue that nothing can
await:

1. `createI18n` declares `fallbackLng: 'en'`. Four `console.ai.*` outbound
   messages are exempted from parity by `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`, and a
   plural category no pack enumerates resolves the same way. With no `en`
   bundle those render as the **raw key**, on screen, in nine languages.
2. `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `LoadingScreen` renders before i18n is usable and on
   the server-down path. Replacing its dictionary with English literals is the
   "delete or untranslate the copy" route objectui#7399 rejected.
3. A caller of the synchronous published `createI18n()` that awaits nothing must
   still get a usable instance.

⇒ the executable criterion's byte half is met in full (nine catalogues, −410,553
bytes). Its **"exactly ONE locale catalogue chunk"** half is met as *exactly one
catalogue fetched beyond the eager closure*: a `zh-CN` load fetches the eager
`i18n-locale-en` plus one `i18n-locale-zh`. Stated rather than smoothed over.

### The `en`-while-loading question — resolved BEFORE render, not documented away

The card allowed either. `apps/console/src/main.tsx` already awaits
`initRuntimeConfig` + `preflightAuth` + `seedTenantLanguage` before
`createRoot().render()`, so the resolve is free:

```ts
await preloadBootstrapLocale({ hasLoader: true });
```

⛔ It runs **after** the `Promise.all`, never inside it: `seedTenantLanguage`
writes the tenant seed, and that seed is tier 2 of the language precedence
chain. Resolving concurrently would preload whatever the previous boot left.

A host with no such seam keeps the documented fallback: correct English strings,
never a raw key, re-rendering when the catalogue lands. Both branches are in
`packages/i18n/README.md` and in `content/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md` § 8b.

## The consumer census — measured, and part of the deliverable

Every in-repo importer of a catalogue or of `builtInLocales`, before the change:

| consumer | what it took | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts` (`createI18n`) | `builtInLocales`, all ten | reads the RESIDENT registry; registers an empty bundle per code so `getAvailableLanguages` and browser detection still see all ten |
| `packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx` | `builtInLocales` for codes + membership | `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES` / `isBuiltInLanguage`, zero payload |
| `packages/app-shell/.../chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx` | `en` + `builtInLocales`, all ten | `en` + `getLoadedBuiltInLocales()`; renders in the active language on any boot that resolved it |
| `packages/app-shell/.../ai/outboundAgentText.ts` | `en` + `zh` packs | resident registry, falling through to `GATE_TEXT`, which its own test pins **byte-identical** to the `zh` pack's four values — so the text that leaves is the same either way |
| `packages/react/src/utils/nonGridRowCeiling.tsx` | `en` | unchanged; `en` is still on the entry |
| `packages/plugin-grid/demo/main.tsx` | all ten | `@object-ui/i18n/locales` — a demo, not a page-load path |
| 13 test files + 2 deep-subpath tests | `builtInLocales` / named packs | `@object-ui/i18n/locales` |
| `scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` | greps SOURCE files to derive which of them import a pack OBJECT, then reads what each one takes off it | ⚠️ **this row was the miss, and it is corrected here.** It never said "untouched" truthfully — this PR had already widened its importer alternation for `getLoadedBuiltInLocales` — and "untouched" would not have been safe either: **untouched is not the same as unaffected**, because three of the rows above change HOW a file reaches a pack, and that is exactly what this script derives. The unwidened half of it is what the merge queue caught. See the ejection section at the top; both halves are now widened together. |
| `examples/console-starter`, `content/docs/*`, `skills/**` | `I18nProvider` only | untouched — **no published example or skill doc imports a pack** |

⇒ the ZONE 3 stop condition "a synchronous import in a published example or
skill doc with no async seam" **does not occur**: the census found no such
consumer. Reported either way, as asked.

## Gates

- **`check:eager-locale-catalogues`** (new) weighs COMPOSITION, not bytes:
  exactly one catalogue in the built eager closure, and it must be the resident
  one. A byte ceiling cannot catch the catalogues returning one at a time inside
  a ceiling's headroom, and cannot tell "left the closure" from "moved to a
  roomier chunk". Two counter-probes make every way of measuring nothing an
  **exit 2** (the gauge), never an exit 0: a catalogue emitted under no chunk of
  its own, and the resident catalogue missing from the eager closure. Wired into
  `performance-budget.yml`, where the full build already happens.
- **`entry-locale-shape-7479.test.ts`** pins the same invariant on the SOURCE,
  so a restored static re-export is legible without a console build. Neither
  half substitutes for the other.
- **Re-baselines, both DOWNWARD and both FOLLOWING the measured drop.**
  `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` 3,597,000 → 3,210,000 over 3,164,817;
  `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS['i18n-locales']` (465,000 over ten catalogues)
  replaced by `['i18n-locale-en']` at 50,000 over 40,415. ⛔ **No ceiling was
  raised.** The aggregate lowering is not optional: left at 3,597,000 over the
  new payload its headroom is 432,183 bytes = 4.74x the regression this gate
  must catch, and `evaluateHeadroomSensitivity` calls that an exit-2 blind
  gauge.
- The `i18n-locales` row in `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES` is **removed, not
  lowered** — its chunk ceased to exist, and the catalogue that remains clears
  the 0.10x floor on its own at 0.11x. That is the debt paid in the only
  currency that table takes.
- **objectui#7489's composition pin is updated in this PR**, as the card asks:
  the per-code probe ids are real catalogue paths now (it pinned an invented
  `zh-CN.ts`), and a new case pins that the ten catalogues get ten DISTINCT
  chunk names — a shared `advancedChunks` group would merge them into one chunk
  and one eager member would make all ten eager again, with every source file
  still reading correctly.
- **`check:i18n-dead-keys`'s pack-object derivation** is widened on BOTH halves
  — population and binding walk — as the ejection section above sets out, with
  seven new shape pins and a two-leg ablation.

## Verification

Every exit code below was captured by REDIRECT before any pipe, and every gate
verdict quoted is the line that gate printed itself.

**The ablation — the lazy boundary removed, on the built bundle.** One catalogue
(`zh`) turned back into a static import inside `locales/registry.ts`, the console
rebuilt, both gates read:

```
on-disk proof: injected marker occurrences=2 (want >=1), removed text occurrences=0 (want 0)
HEAD blob:    f2ab8186b78bd4341bfffee5f21fb3f50f98abba
mutated blob: 251ad6e9543c7eeae649df56469e4e6e38c19e65

check:eager-locale-catalogues UNDER ABLATION: exit 1
  ❌ 1 non-resident locale catalogue(s) are in the console's EAGER closure: zh.
check:eager-closure UNDER ABLATION: exit 2
  ❌ aggregate closure  3133.8 KB measured / 3134.8 KB ceiling (headroom 1.0 KB = 0.01x)
```

Restored, and proven clean **by state**, never by an exit code — the restore is
`git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, never the bare form, which restores from the index:

```
git diff HEAD --stat   -> empty
git status --porcelain -> empty
git hash-object packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts  f2ab8186b78bd4341bfffee5f21fb3f50f98abba
git rev-parse HEAD:packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts f2ab8186b78bd4341bfffee5f21fb3f50f98abba
grep -c zhAblation ... -> 0
```

⭐ The ablation also found a real defect in the gate I had just written: it
printed a red verdict naming `zh` above a size table labelling `zh` "on demand",
because the table read each row's label from its CODE rather than from the eager
set. Fixed in its own commit; the deferred total had the same bug and claimed a
saving the bundle had not made.

**Tests** — repo-root invocations, path filters, no `--` (`89ea9b1`, the head
that entered the merge queue; the merged tree is re-verified in the ejection
section above):

| run | result |
|---|---|
| `packages/i18n/ packages/components/ packages/fields/` | 483 files, 6210 tests, **all passing** |
| `scripts/__tests__/ packages/app-shell/ apps/console/ packages/plugin-{charts,chatbot,grid}/ packages/react/` | 1224 files, 15007 tests, 3 failed → 2 fixed here, 1 pre-existing (below) |
| everything else under `packages/` and `examples/` | 1145 files, 15989 tests, **all passing** |
| `packages/app-shell/.../AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx` after its fix | 10 tests, passing |

**Gates on `89ea9b1`**, all exit 0: `check:eager-closure`,
`check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:entry-guard`,
`check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`,
`check:dist-completeness`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:i18n-keys`,
`check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`,
`check:published-dist`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:doc-fences`,
`check:doc-types`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`,
`check:docs-route-closure`, `check:lint-rule-coverage`,
`check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`,
`check-governed-queue-guard --self-test`. Type-check: `@object-ui/i18n`,
`app-shell`, `components`, `fields`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-chatbot`,
`plugin-grid`, `console`, and `tsconfig.vitest-setup.json` — all exit 0.

**Lint — a DECLARED narrowing, with all three pieces of evidence.** `pnpm lint`
is a repo-wide scan CI owns; this branch ran the 41 changed lintable files
instead, and that narrowing excludes nothing this diff could have moved:

1. **The population** is read from eslint's OWN resolved config, not from my
   reading of `eslint.config.js`: `calculateConfigForFile` reports
   `languageOptions.parserOptions.project = null` and `projectService = null`.
2. **The count** is from `--format json`: 41 files linted, **0 errors**, 76
   warnings — 67 `no-explicit-any`, 8 `react-refresh/only-export-components`,
   1 `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`, all pre-existing classes, none of them
   gating (no `--max-warnings` anywhere). The 7 files this PR adds carry 0 of
   either.
3. **The invariance**: with type-aware linting OFF, no rule's verdict on an
   untouched file can depend on any file in this diff, so a whole-repo run
   could differ only on files this diff does not contain.

**NOT MEASURED**, named rather than glossed: `check:node-esm-load` exits 1 in
this container for a reason it prints itself — turbo shares one cache across
every worktree of a checkout, so 7 package entries here were REPLAYED from a
sibling agent's tree and the gate refuses to grade artifacts it did not build.
None of the 7 is a package this diff touches. It suggests `--force-build`; CI
builds fresh and never meets this.

## Acceptance notes

### Out of scope, filed, not fixed here

- **objectui#9124** — `scripts/__tests__/check-side-effects-array.test.ts` reds
  on any tree where `packages/layout/dist/index.umd.cjs` exists. Its assertion
  turns on `fs.existsSync` against a **gitignored build artifact**, so building
  the workspace reds it and CI never sees it. Measured both directions on one
  tree (44 passed with the one artifact moved aside, 1 failed with it present),
  and proven not to be this diff: this PR touches no manifest declaring a
  `sideEffects` array and does not touch `packages/layout` at all. Third
  measured instance of the class objectui#6893 / objectui#7460 / objectui#7671
  named; none of those three covers this file.

### Noted, not filed

- The turbo shared-cache `check:node-esm-load` refusal above is the gate working
  as designed and saying so in its own output — a container condition, not a
  defect. Successor: none; it self-clears on a fresh build.
- `packages/i18n`'s `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings grew from 6
  to 8 (the two new bootstrap helpers). Same pre-existing class in a file that
  has always exported non-components; not gating, and splitting the module to
  silence it would scatter the bootstrap contract.
- **The population half of `derivePackObjectImporters()` is looser than the
  binding half is now**, and deliberately left that way here. It selects with
  `line.includes` on the package name, so a hypothetical package whose name
  merely STARTS WITH the pack package would enter the population while binding
  nothing — the same silent-file shape the queue caught, from the other side. No
  such package exists in this tree, so it is unreachable today; tightening the
  population test is a change to a gate another card just landed, with no
  instance to measure it against. Successor: the next card that touches
  `derivePackObjectImporters()`.
- **`check:changeset-claims` (report-only) names six pending changesets whose
  bodies mention a file this PR touches.** Read: all six still true. The two that
  name `scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` claim it stays REPORT-ONLY by design
  (unchanged here) and that `LoadingScreen.tsx`'s reads are invisible to both
  LEGS of the sweep (also unchanged — the repair widens the reads DERIVATION, not
  either leg's probe). The other four predate this repair and were already in the
  set before it.

### Decisions taken in the open, each with its alternative

- **`en` stays eager.** Argued above and in `locales/registry.ts`. The
  alternative — all ten lazy — costs raw keys on screen in nine languages
  wherever parity is exempted, and either English literals or an awaited splash
  in `@object-ui/app-shell`'s server-down boot path.
- **Resolve before render, rather than documenting the flash away.** The console
  had an await to spend; hosts without one keep the documented fallback, and
  both branches are in the README and in the troubleshooting guide.
- **The DOM test projects seed the catalogues in ONE place.** 49 test files in 8
  packages mount a provider in a non-`en` locale and assert on the same tick. I
  tried the per-file seam first, at 12 files, and it did not scale — and should
  not: it is ceremony plus a standing trap for the next locale test anyone
  writes. `vitest.setup.i18n-catalogues.ts` puts the DOM projects in the state
  `apps/console/src/main.tsx` reaches by awaiting `preloadBootstrapLocale()`,
  at approximately zero cost against `main` (those tests already loaded all ten
  before this card). ⛔ It is not what keeps the payload claim honest, and its
  header names the three things that are — the built-bundle gate, the
  entry-shape pin, and the lazy-runtime suite, which takes a fresh module graph
  precisely so the setup cannot reach it.
- **The queue repair is a widening of the gate, not a relaxation of it**, and the
  boundary is stated because it is one: objectui#9046 landed that assertion hours
  ago. Both changes are additive to what the instrument can SEE; the assertion,
  its wording, and its empty-list expectation are untouched. The alternative —
  reverting either consumer to a static pack import — would put a 156 KB
  catalogue back on the page-load path to satisfy a derivation, which is the
  payload this card exists to remove.
